title: From National Curricula to Cultural Awareness: Constructing Open-Ended Culture-Specific Question Answering Dataset
reasoning: The paper focuses on building a dataset for cultural awareness and alignment based on national social studies curricula. Although it mentions 'Moral Education' and 'civic norms' in the context of what a society prioritizes, it does not explicitly evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or philosophical ethics as a central component, focusing instead on sociocultural and geopolitical context.
